interventions.action: Installed playwright-core in ./.scratch/browser and drove the system Chromium against `vite preview` of the production build. TMPDIR pointed at a short /tmp/lrdr path, deleted afterwards. The script checked layout at 375px and 1280px, sideways overflow, computed --ult-* values and color-scheme on the root, a control and the portalled Select popup, data-theme overrides, reduced motion, the empty-name error, opening the Select from the keyboard and closing it with Escape, and adding new and existing donations.

decisions.choice: Choose the category with a portalled Ultima Select inside an inline form, not a form in a Dialog.
options: Portalled Select in an inline form
decisions.why: The form stays visible beside the stock at the intake desk. Select already opens from the keyboard, closes on Escape and returns focus to its trigger, and the popup portals to body, where the root CSS theme reaches it.

decisions.choice: Put the layout breakpoint in the app token module (screen.stylex.ts) as `stylex.defineConsts`, next to the app's `defineVars` sizes.
options: Named constant in the file that uses it (llms.txt principle, Sidebar precedent)
defineConsts in the app's .stylex.ts token module
decisions.why: The brief says the app sets no lengths outside its theme and token modules. A media condition cannot read a custom property, so a compile-time const in the token module satisfies both rules.

decisions.choice: Selected stock rows use --ult-color-accent-subtle as their background, through ToggleGroup.Item's style slot. The hovered pressed state uses the compound key that toggle-group.tsx uses.
options: Override the pressed fill with an accent role
Drop the Card around the list
decisions.why: Card.Root paints --ult-color-surface-raised, so the default pressed fill was invisible inside the Card (seen in screenshots). The accent is the brand mark, not a status, so success, warning and danger keep their meanings. The nested `':is([data-pressed])': { ':hover' }` form from the conventions fails @stylexjs/valid-styles, so I used `':is([data-pressed]):hover'` as the installed toggle-group.tsx does.

decisions.choice: Did not load the Figtree or IBM Plex Mono font files the theme names. The app renders with the exported fallback stacks.
options: Load the faces (e.g. self-host or a font package)
decisions.why: The guidance allows either. Loading would mean a new dependency or a third-party host, and the brief limits the run to Ultima's public host.

decisions.choice: Skipped the optional agent setup (`git init` then `ultima install --harness <name>`) that the init report offered.
options: git init and install the skill and hooks in ./larder
decisions.why: It was optional. It would have made ./larder a git repository and added harness files, and the hosted llms.txt and guides that the skill points to were already available.

decisions.choice: No in-app light/dark switch. The root follows the system preference, and `data-theme` on <html> can pin a mode.
decisions.why: The theme guidance says not to add a separate mode switch for the theme artifact. Both modes and both explicit overrides were checked in the production build.
